Licence: public domain (Unlicense) OR MIT-0, at the user's choice (full text at the
end of each header). Used by llaudiofiledecode.cpp (sound uploader: FLAC and MP3
input). dr_mp3 applies LAME/Xing encoder delay and padding for gapless decoding.

replace the files, update the versions above and in newview/licenses-*.txt.
